pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/SetupWizard.tsx:108 At the admission door a project is matched and admitted by its lowercased filesystem path and display name, with no minted identity and no fingerprint/re-bind choice, so a re-clone or move to a new path admits an amnesiac twin.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/SetupWizard.tsx:108 Collision/duplicate check keys on path; admission passes only {projectName, projectPath} to the store, and downstream rows are keyed by hash of normalized path.

src/components/modules/project-setup/SetupWizard.tsx:96 Open-existing marks setup complete right away. There is no metadata-contract equip step, no explicitly deferred gaps, and no closed lifecycle vocabulary (only the isSetupComplete/isNewProject booleans).

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/UnifiedSummaryView/useUnifiedSummaryView.ts:105 The composite is over modules of one project, not across projects.
src/components/modules/evaluator/UnifiedSummaryView/useUnifiedSummaryView.ts:56 There is no portfolio wall to drill from; the view reads one project's dashboards.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/project-setup/PathBrowser/types.ts:32 It only emits candidate name+path; identity minting is the admission door's job (project-setup-core).

pairs.subject: multi-project
pairs.evidence: src/stores/projectStore.ts:262 Switching to a recent project restores its module progress by joining on the filesystem path (the recent_projects id is itself hash16 of the normalized path). A moved or re-cloned project therefore loses its checklist history and appears as a fresh twin.

techniques.evidence: src/stores/projectStore.ts:262 Progress is joined by path. ProjectModuleBridge save/load/auto-save all take projectPath, and the row id is derived from the path (progressRowId = hash16(normalizeProjectId(path))).

src/stores/navigationStore.ts:34 View state (activeCategory/activeSubModule/moduleTabs) is one global persisted slot keyed by moduleId, not by project, so project B opens on project A's view after switchProject.

src/stores/projectStore.ts:274 Removal is a hard DELETE of the registry row (route: DELETE FROM recent_projects) with no archived state and no enumerate-and-confirm step. The lifecycle is only isSetupComplete/isNewProject booleans.
